comments.author: @KurtHanssen-f1v
comments.text: I lived in San Juan from 1966 to 1967, worked as a cook at the Holiday Inn in Isla Verde, close to the airport, and back then I made $.3.60/hr. I lived in Cas.a del Mar near Club Náutico. The Boriquitas were very friendly.

replies.author: @GlobalJourNey-8386
replies.text: "Thank you so much for sharing your wonderful memories! It’s amazing to hear about your experience living and working in San Juan back in the 60s. The warmth and hospitality of the Puerto Rican people are truly timeless. Warm regards!"
